title: Range Select Guard
summary: Reads back how many rows a shift-click just selected, with Undo, so a runaway range selection doesn't act on rows nobody saw.
description: Selectable list that reads back how many rows a shift-click range selected (with Undo), skips and reports rows hidden by the filter, flags rows on pages never opened with an "only this page" fix, and calls out selected rows a filter now hides.
catches: Shift-click ranges much larger than intended
Rows hidden by the filter: skipped and reported
Selected rows on pages never opened
Selected rows that a filter now hides, with deselect
limits: Works on the rows you pass; server-side "select all" isn't covered
Bulk actions are yours to gate
a11y: Pagination buttons have aria-labels; the page indicator is a polite live region
Selection readback is a polite live region
Focus stays on the clicked row; highlight motion is skipped under reduced motion
